race.comment: SUNROE (3) went forward and gave a great sight before finishing third last time out over 1600m at Wagga. Finds the right race this time and can run another big race.  LOST YA SOCK (12) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1400m at Hay, beaten 6 lengths into fifth. Best figures measure up nicely. Sure to run well. ANLADIO (4) was well in commission last time out but could only manage to finish seventh over 2100m at Orange in a disappointing performance. Nicely placed to turn things around. SO REGAL (10) has been settling too far back over shorter trips, and while she'll likely get back again she'll have more time to round them up. Watch for her charging late.
